title: Owner-authorized track audio attachment operations
purpose: Provide explicit server-side attach and detach operations for assigning project-owned private audio assets to project tracks without widening ordinary track metadata update authority.

canonicalRelationship.projectAudioAssetIds: Canonical inventory of audio assets belonging to the project.
canonicalRelationship.trackAudioAssetIds: Ordered organizational references assigning project-owned audio assets to a track.

attach: Read canonical project snapshot and recheck owner identity.
Require trackId to be attached to the project.
Require audioAssetId to be present in project.audioAssetIds.
Read canonical audio metadata and require asset.projectId to equal projectId.
Read canonical track snapshot and require track.projectId to equal projectId.
If already attached, return canonical track idempotently without a write.
Otherwise append audioAssetId using revision-gated track CAS.
Verify the returned canonical track contains the attachment and preserves immutable identity.
detach: Read canonical project snapshot and recheck owner identity.
Require trackId to be attached to the project.
Read canonical track snapshot and require track.projectId to equal projectId.
If the audioAssetId is absent from the track, return canonical track idempotently without a write.
Otherwise remove audioAssetId using revision-gated track CAS.
Verify the returned canonical track no longer contains the attachment and preserves immutable identity.
deferred: Track ordering of audio clips beyond append order.
